thread:
toni: Morning thought: should the elevator have a playlist or is that personal-space violation? :thinking_face:
jamal: 100% playlist. Morning ska surprise wakes me up faster than coffee. :sunglasses:
lee: Please no. Last time the elevator played polka for a week. I still hear accordions in my sleep. :sweat_smile:
alexa: What about a rotating 15-min 'commute' playlist that changes each day? Sign-up sheet on the kitchen board.
jamal: I'll take Thursdays. I bring vintage mixtapes (aka curated spotify). :musical_note:
ops-bot: note: elevator-amiable-volume set to 40% during 08:30-09:30 per consensus. ambient-sensor: active. :gear:
toni: Also propose an 'elevator DJ' badge so people know when to expect weird song choices. :badge:
lee: If someone plays 90s boy bands one more time I am staging a sit-in. :raised_hand:
alexa: compromise: Monday = chill lo-fi, Tue = staff picks, Wed = instrumental only, Thu = jamal's mystery set, Fri = office anthems (no more than 3 singalongs).
jamal: Friday office anthems = instant karaoke. I'm in. :microphone:
toni: Vote: adopt schedule. React with :thumbsup: to agree.
ops-bot: poll started: "Adopt elevator playlist schedule?" options: yes / no / veto (with tambourine). Poll ends in 2h.
lee: voted no, but will respect the lo-fi. Also bringing earplugs for the polka survivors. :ear:
alexa: Thank you team. If you're volunteering a playlist, DM me the link and I'll add it to the shared folder. :sparkles:
